svg.title: One yarn panel, two mathematical records
svg.desc: Four rows of twenty-four schematic stitches are divided into four six-stitch sections. Pink counts alternate between three one three one and one three one three. Each row has eight pink stitches. A rank-one uniform approximation has two pink stitches per section, preserving the row totals but losing alternation. The sixteen section counts each change by one, for squared record error sixteen. V marks are schematic cell symbols, not loop-topology instructions. Rows are displayed in record order.
svg.text: The same swatch: baseline + alternating repeat
Count actual stitches first. Let the pattern—not a new metaphor—supply the mathematics.
Both panels: 32 pink + 64 green stitches. Different spatial pattern.
Raw SVD strengths: 8 and 4. Keeping the baseline loses alternation; squared count-record error = 16.
